label: Changes feed (Sync Gateway)
type: the REST/WebSocket API surface streaming document changes to replicating clients, via one of four connection methods (polling, longpoll, continuous - all based on the historical CouchDB _changes API - and Sync Gateway's own websocket addition). Trades off against sgw:webhook as the two mechanisms for reacting to document changes.
note: Never states or alludes to DCP anywhere on its own page - the round's flagged open question (does sgw:changes-feed relate to Couchbase's DCP protocol) is left unresolved rather than guessed at; no usesProtocol relation to protocol:dcp is recorded.
